mode.snapsDesc: Each audio posts as a reply under the latest peak.snaps container — shows in the Snaps feed (default).
mode.singleDesc: One audio in its own top-level Hive post, with a title, community, tags & cover.
mode.albumDesc: One main post (no audio) acting as a landing page; every track is published as a comment reply with its own cover, description, payout & beneficiaries.
mode.postRewardsDesc: You receive the normal Hive author payout — paid out once, ~7 days after publishing.
mode.pplDesc: All audio-post rewards go to @{{account}}. Instead of a single payout, a 3Speak program pays you per listen for the lifetime of the track.

tracks.helpSnaps: Each track is published as its own snap. Set shared values once and apply them to all, then override per track.
